Globex's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred to the account team/security as a separate, scoped machine-credential proposal (e.g. restricted, revocable service tokens) needing security sign-off. Nothing in the code is changed for it now.

Code settings stated alongside in artifacts/t13-reuse-billing-cycle/billing-plan.md: billing.cycle = AX-74889, billing.currency = AX-59699 (repo/billing.py). The X-Core-Key header is only for the later service-account keys; user traffic stays JWT per D-t05.
